visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of six young adults, three men and three women, are seen posing in a brightly lit indoor space. They stand in front of a yellow wall with a circular blue logo containing the text 'MILES PLAYER'. The individuals are dressed in varied casual styles including denim jackets, hoodies, and vests. They wave and smile enthusiastically at the camera, projecting a joyful and welcoming atmosphere. (2) The scene cuts to a medium close-up of a young woman with short brown hair, wearing a pink cardigan over a white blouse. She is inside a busy restaurant with steam rising from hotpot tables in the background. She waves her hands playfully and flashes a peace sign while grinning widely. The lighting is warm and natural for an indoor dining setting. (3) A series of rapid cuts showcase event-related objects: a green mesh tote bag with a white Cathay Pacific logo is held up; a large plastic jug of tea featuring a white dog on the label and the text '白狗汁' is placed on a table; and circular signs with an 'A' logo and airplane icons hang from the ceiling, rotating slowly. (4) A female DJ with dark hair tied back is seen performing at a specialized booth decorated with a large cutout of a white airplane. She wears a floral patterned top and waves one hand in the air to the rhythm. In the foreground and background, various guests are seated at round red tables, engaged in conversation and eating hotpot. (5) The final sequence shows the DJ continuing her set with high energy while people in the restaurant cheer. The camera captures wide shots of the venue, highlighting the collaboration between the airline and the restaurant with numerous branded posters and decorations visible on the walls.
